Game Overview

Dangerous Rescue puts players into a adventure experience centered on pilot a rescue helicopter through treacherous landscapes in Dangerous Rescue. With intuitive controls, navigate mountains and save lives. Balance speed and caution to master thrilling missions, test your skills, and enjoy breathtaking scenery while ensuring safe, swift rescues. Speed and precision earn you top scores in this exhilarating adventure.
